entry.title: JOYA Black Cigarillos — Pack of 10
experienceTags: Occasion: Quick rich smoke, after a meal, casual evening smoke
entry.summaryHtml: Cocoa, sweet tobacco, fruit, nuts and pepper are the expected core of this compact San Andrés cigarillo. Joya describes the Black blend as medium-bodied but full-flavoured, with a Mexican San Andrés wrapper over an all-Nicaraguan core; reports on the 4″ × 32 cigarillo add an initial pepper hit followed by sweeter fruit, cocoa and a nutty finish. It should be the smoother and sweeter of the two Joya cigarillos being added, with less nicotine than Antaño but a strong chance of better flavour density for this catalogue.
entry.noteHtml: Untasted. The Index currently lists the exact cigarillo singly at A$13 and the pack of 10 at A$119; Flavour remains unrated until personally tasted.
